approach: Static recompilation of the retail XBE to C++; XDK HLE with a Direct3D 12 renderer and XAudio2 on Windows, and a native Vulkan renderer with SDL3 on Linux (no Wine)
help: Fix the allocation-ordering defect in the Vulkan backend: UploadAlloc and AllocDrawSet read Cur().used / Cur().pool without EnsureRecording(), so after a mid-frame Submit a draw can be given constants at a stale offset and a descriptor set from a pool BeginTargetPass is about to reset (found by code reading in sdk/runtime/gpu/vulkan.cpp; corroborated by a validation run reporting an unbound descriptor set after BlockOnResource read-backs)

Play visible gameplay end to end: saving and reloading through visible play, the remaining cheat rows in play (only Give Money's setter entry is logged), and the per-call frame-rate consumers docs/frame-rate.md lists as unproven leads
Exercise a real controller: no gamepad has ever been plugged into the test machine, so the SDL gamepad path is unexercised
Hor+ ultrawide on the Vulkan backend: today the picture is pillarboxed at the title's own 4:3, and widening every viewport/scissor/2-D placement by the offset is its own piece of work
Build and test the Windows target (Direct3D 12 + XAudio2): it has never been compiled, as the development machine has no MSVC or Windows SDK

Name the remaining genuinely unmatched XDK names in config/game.toml (7 crt_* math entries; the other 41 names at 0 are for sections this XBE does not have) and the graded D3D candidates in docs/d3d-gap-functions.md
Find any further indirect-call entry points the recompiler's analysis missed, as it missed 0x2283CD and 0x66980 (both indirect calls through stored function pointers); more may exist
notes: In progress - boots, renders, reaches playable gameplay: the native Linux build (Vulkan + SDL3, no Wine) boots and drives title, main menu, save select, name entry and Create-a-Sim on screen, saves a Sim, and loads a playable household at 2181 draws/frame with 0 skipped and 0 nopipeline (out/shots/house3_house.png shows the club, the Sims, the HUD and a dialogue). The household formerly presented black and dropped 159-267 draws/frame: the per-frame descriptor pool held 2048 sets against ~2175 draws, so allocation failed part way through the frame (split counter: shader 0 pso 0 set 264) and the present blit, which takes its set from the same pool, was skipped; the pool is now 8192 sets (sdk 4888bc1). Game speed is measured at 1.000 game-seconds per real second at fps_cap 60, 144 and uncapped (SIMSBO_NO_STEP controls 1.112, 2.400, ~23.3). F1/F2 panels apply settings live, keyboard-as-pad is screenshot-proven, and Give Money was entered through the game's own setter (cheat mask 02). The retail USA XBE (title id 0x45410043, built 2003-11-13, XDK 5558) recompiles to 27,492 functions; config/game.toml names 194 of 242 symbols and 12 of 12 data symbols. Unproven: the allocation-ordering defect in UploadAlloc/AllocDrawSet (being fixed), saving/reloading through visible play, the remaining cheat rows in play, the per-call frame-rate consumers in docs/frame-rate.md, Hor+ ultrawide (pillarboxed at the title's own 4:3 today), and any real gamepad - no controller has ever been plugged into the test machine. The Windows target (Direct3D 12 + XAudio2) has never been compiled: the development machine has no MSVC or Windows SDK, so all _WIN32 paths are untested. Operational warning: do not load the Vulkan validation layer (XBE_VK_DEBUG) on the test machine - it hard-froze the machine twice, each time under 0.5 s after a periodic frame capture, with no kernel message; no run without the layer has ever frozen.
